rationale: Price has stabilized tightly around $22.14 over the last five candles with higher lows on the most recent bar ($22.16 close), suggesting the staircase recovery thesis is still marginally intact and the 9-EMA at $22.15 is being tested rather than broken. The invalidation at $21.93 has not been triggered, and with 117 minutes remaining there is time for the VWAP magnetic pull to reassert. However, the complete absence of favorable excursion since entry and the flat, low-range consolidation near the session low keep conviction very low.
